sentences.text: Frederick `` Fred '' Seibert -LRB- born September 15 , 1951 -RRB- is a serial entrepreneur and American television and film producer .	serial entrepreneur	serial entrepreneur
He owns Frederator Networks , Inc. and Frederator Studios .	Frederator Studios	Frederator Studios
